name: Bologna industrial technician seeking a predictable schedule

context.geography: Bologna area, Italy; manageable daily commute
constraints: Must distinguish day work from on-call duties
context.company_awareness: Knows nearby manufacturing names but sees many anonymous recruiter listings.

trigger: Another rota change interferes with planned commitments, making a predictable local role more attractive than headline salary alone.

searches_run.observation: Retrieved several recruiter listings with permanent labels and local municipalities. Direct Adecco inspection confirms direct permanent hiring but also emergency on-call duties; full-time label does not resolve schedule.

searches_run.query: manutentore Bologna orario giornaliero no turni tempo indeterminato
searches_run.observation: Results remained a mix of relevant maintenance listings and irrelevant schedule documents. No retrieved evidence established a dependable no-shift filter.

best_entry_page.primary_query: manutentore Bologna orario giornaliero tempo indeterminato
best_entry_page.promise: Find covered maintenance employers and compare contract, plant location and stated hours, distinguishing rotating shifts from emergency on-call.
best_entry_page.cta: Search permanent maintenance openings and follow local covered manufacturers.
proof_needed: Explicit shift/day/on-call evidence and unknown handling
Plant location instead of recruiter branch address
Do not claim commute-time filtering without implementation

conversion_objections: Most results hide the manufacturer behind an agency.
Daytime work can still include emergency calls.
Bologna province is too large to assume a practical commute.

avoid_targeting.reason: No schedule guarantee from missing text.
Payroll/legal calculation is outside job discovery.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Cambierei per un orario chiaro e una sede raggiungibile, non solo per una RAL maggiore. Fatemi vedere cosa dice l'annuncio su turni e reperibilità, e non scambiate tempo pieno per lavoro in giornata.
